hook.name: DuelHook
hook.description: A Uniswap v4 hook shared across three pools per prediction-market duel pair (ETH/A, ETH/D, and cross A/D). Takes ETH swap fees and burns cross-pool switch fees, runs zero-fee internal arbitrage to keep pools aligned, and settles periodic 4-hour rounds by buying back the winning token near its 30-minute EMA reference price.
